description: Publishes privacy-minimized California ABC source-defined active issued-license premise groups from the official daily export.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS HEAD/GET requests to the exact official DailyExport-CSV.zip path.
retry: Retry HTTP 408, 425, 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, schema drift, archive-member drift, duplicate selected identities, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: Pin HEAD metadata, download one exact archive, validate the one-member CSV and 26-column fingerprint, discard mailing and unselected rows while writing the selected snapshot, delete the raw archive, then publish the verified manifest and pointer atomically.
idempotency: The source Last-Modified instant, archive byte length, archive SHA-256, and selected-source SHA-256 identify a source release. File Number identifies one source-preserving licensee/premise group regardless of active license-type row count.
cancellation: Abort acquisition and normalization cooperatively, close streams, leave the prior current pointer unchanged, and retain only unpublished run-scoped diagnostic staging.
retention_profile: Retain immutable privacy-minimized selected-source and governed normalized releases; never retain the raw archive containing excluded mailing fields.
